existing_api.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "caliper"
version = "0.2.32"
description = "Caliper — fully deterministic dependency and code review for CI"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
readme = "README.md"
license = {file = "LICENSE"}
authors = [
]
keywords = ["security", "code-review", "dependency-review", "sarif", "ci", "devsecops"]
classifiers = [
]
dependencies = [
    "click==8.4.2",
    "pydantic==2.13.4",
    "structlog==26.1.0",
    "httpx==0.28.1",
    "orjson==3.11.9",
    "packaging==26.2",
    "jinja2==3.1.6",
    "pyyaml==6.0.3",
    "rich==15.0.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
db = [
    "psycopg[binary]==3.3.4",
]
parquet = [
    "pyarrow==24.0.0",
]
webhook = [
    "starlette==1.3.1",
    "uvicorn==0.49.0",
]
watch = [
    "watchdog==6.0.0",
]
all = [
]

[project.scripts]
caliper = "caliper.cli.main:cli"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/gitrdunhq/caliper"
Repository = "https://github.com/gitrdunhq/caliper"
Changelog = "https://github.com/gitrdunhq/caliper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md"
Issues = "https://github.com/gitrdunhq/caliper/issues"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/caliper"]
artifacts = ["**/*.j2", "**/part_ui_dist/*", "**/complexity_helper_dist/*"]
only-include = ["src/caliper"]

[tool.uv]
package = true
exclude-newer = "7 days"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest==9.1.1",
    "black==26.5.1",
    "ruff==0.15.20",
    "respx==0.23.1",
    "hypothesis==6.155.7",
    "packaging==26.2",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 100

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "N", "UP", "B", "SIM"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**" = ["E402", "E501", "SIM117", "SIM105", "SIM102", "B017", "B905", "F841"]
"src/caliper/detectors/**/*.py" = ["SIM102", "SIM110", "SIM105", "E501"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["caliper"]

[tool.black]
target-version = ["py312"]
line-length = 100

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
markers = [
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["src/caliper/core"]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
fail_under = 75
